_description: Phase 12 undo/redo regression case, against fixtures/patterns/blank.val. Exercises: session.undoStatus's label window before any undo; a multi-VUndoCommand action (point.edit setting both "length" and "angle" on an endLine-created point, which pushes two separate SaveToolOptions commands) undoing fully in exactly one session.undo call, including correctly reverted live geometry (x/y), not just the DOM; session.undo with "count" larger than the remaining stack (a clean partial result, not an error); and the verified, documented KNOWN GAP that undoing an object's *creation* (basePoint/endLine/line, all AddToCalc-backed) does NOT prune the live VContainer -- unlike the point.edit case, the post-undo pattern.dump below still reports the created points, unchanged, even once the whole stack is undone. See session_undo_handlers.h's own "CRITICAL, VERIFIED FINDING" comment for the full writeup this golden file locks in.
